661: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਰਹੀਐ. ਨਾਨਕ; ਕਿਛੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
Nanak: as long as we live in the world, we should hear and speak of the Lord.
ਭਾਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਮ. ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਮਰਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੫॥੨॥
We have searched and found no lasting home here; so while alive, let us die to worldly desires. ॥5॥2॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
How can I remember Him? He cannot be remembered by cleverness or force.
Without His remembrance the heart burns and the soul cries out.
The True Lord creates beings and Himself makes their lives beautiful.
If we forget Him, how can life ever be good? ॥1॥
He is not found by cleverness or by claiming a right,
ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲਉ; ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
so how can I meet the True One, O my mother? ॥1॥ Rahao
Without His grace, no one goes to assay the merchandise of the Name,
ਨਾ ਕੋ ਚਾਖੈ; ਨਾ ਕੋ ਖਾਇ ॥
no one tastes it, and no one eats it.
Satisfying the world brings no honour before the Lord;
ਤਾ ਪਤਿ ਰਹੈ; ਰਾਖੈ ਜਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
honour is kept only when He Himself keeps it. ॥2॥
Wherever I look, You are present there, O Lord;
without You there is no other refuge.
ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ; ਕੀਤੈ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
If someone makes efforts through cleverness, what can such efforts achieve?
Only the one whom the True Lord blesses meets Him. ॥3॥
ਹੁਣਿ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਣਾ; ਮੁਹਤਿ. ਕਿ ਤਾਲਿ ॥
Soon we must rise and depart, in a moment or an instant.
ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸਾ; ਗੁਣ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
What face will I show? I will have no virtues with me.
As the Lord casts His glance, so does one become;
Nanak: without His glance of grace, no one is joined to Him. ॥4॥1॥3॥
When He casts His glance of grace, then He can be remembered.
The soul softens, and stays lovingly attuned to Him.
Such a one sees their own self and others' as one,
and the duality within dies away within. ॥1॥
By the Guru's grace His remembrance is obtained;
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗੈ; ਫਿਰਿ. ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
when the mind is attached to the Lord, the fear of death no longer consumes it. ॥1॥ Rahao
Remembering the True One, true understanding dawns;
ਤਾ ਤੇ; ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਰਹੈ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
by that light one remains detached while living amid Maya.
Such is the greatness of the True Guru,
that one attains the highest state while living among children and spouse. ॥2॥
The true servant renders such service,
ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ; ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਧਰੈ ॥
offering up the soul to the One who gave it.
Whoever pleases the Master is approved;
that servant receives honour in the Lord's court. ॥3॥
The servant who enshrines the Guru's spiritual form, the Shabad, in the heart
The True Master shows such grace to that one,
ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ; ਜਮ ਤੇ ਕੈਸਾ ਡਰੈ ॥੪॥
that the servant need no longer fear death. ॥4॥
Says Nanak: when one reflects on the Guru's Word
and loves the true Bani of the Lord's praise,
then one finds the door of liberation.
ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸਭੁ; ਇਹੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੫॥੨॥੪॥
This sublime Shabad is all chanting and all austerity. ॥5॥2॥4॥
Forgetting the Word of praise, the soul burns again and again;
burning and burning, it wastes away in ever more corruption.
The one who forgets the Bani of the Lord's praise
cries out like one with a chronic disease. ॥1॥
Complaining at length is idle chatter;
ਵਿਣੁ ਬੋਲੇ; ਜਾਣੈ ਸਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He knows everything without being told. ॥1॥ Rahao
Remember the One who made the ears, the eyes and the nose,
who gave the tongue that speaks so quickly,
662: who placed warmth in the body and kept the soul within it,
by whose power the breath blows and one can speak and move everywhere. ॥2॥
All attachment, worldly love and pleasures of taste
only blacken the mind, stain upon stain.
With the stains of sin upon the forehead one departs,
and finds no place to sit in the Lord's court. ॥3॥
Only by Your grace is one given to chant Your Name, O Lord;
ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਤਰਣਾ; ਹੋਰੁ. ਨਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
attached to it one crosses over; there is no other refuge.
ਜੇ ਕੋ ਡੂਬੈ; ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਰ ॥
Even if someone is drowning, He still takes care of them;
Nanak: the True Lord is the Giver to all. ॥4॥3॥5॥
If a thief flatters the judge, the judge is not convinced;
ਜੇ ਬਦੀ ਕਰੇ. ਤਾ ਤਸੂ, ਨ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
if the thief speaks ill of him, he is not shaken in the least.
ਚੋਰ ਕੀ ਹਾਮਾ; ਭਰੇ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
No one vouches for a thief;
how can one known as a thief be thought good? ॥1॥
Listen, O mind, blind, greedy as a dog, and false:
the truthful one is recognised without a word. ॥1॥ Rahao
A thief may look handsome and act clever,
but a counterfeit coin is worth only a couple of shells.
Even if it is kept and mixed with genuine coins,
when assayed it is found counterfeit. ॥2॥
As one acts, so one receives;
one sows and oneself eats the fruit.
Even if one swears by one's own greatness,
one walks the path of one's own inner inclination. ॥3॥
One may tell a hundred lies and false tales,
and tell them to the whole world, yet no one can deceive You, O Lord.
If it pleases You, even a simple, sincere person is approved.
Nanak: the wise Knower of hearts knows all. ॥4॥4॥6॥
The body is the paper, and the mind is the decree written on it;
ਸਿਰ ਕੇ ਲੇਖ; ਨ ਪੜੈ ਇਆਣਾ ॥
but the foolish one does not read what is written on the forehead.
By the Lord's law, the impressions of deeds done under the three qualities are engraved there.
See, just as a counterfeit coin is useless, so is the record of false deeds. ॥1॥
Nanak: if there is silver in the coin,
ਖਰਾ ਖਰਾ; ਆਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
everyone calls it genuine, genuine. ॥1॥ Rahao
The Qazi tells lies and eats filth, taking bribes;
the Brahmin torments people and then bathes at pilgrim places;
the Yogi is blind and does not know the way to live.
All three are spiritually empty within. ॥2॥
He is a Yogi who understands the true way of life,
and by the Guru's grace comes to know the One.
He is a Qazi who turns his mind away from ill-gotten gain,
and by the Guru's grace dies to worldly desire while alive.
He is a Brahmin who fixes his mind on the all-pervading Lord;
he crosses over himself, and carries all his generations across. ॥3॥
Wise is the one who washes the evil from the heart;
a Muslim is the one who removes the filth within.
The learned one who understands the true path is approved,
bearing on the forehead the mark of the Lord's court. ॥4॥5॥7॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਕਾਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ. ਜੋਗੁ ਨਾਹੀ; ਨਾਹੀ ਸਤ ਕਾ ਢਬੁ ॥
This human life is not the time for closing eyes and holding the nose; such practices bring no union with the Lord, and no higher conduct.
ਥਾਨਸਟ ਜਗ ਭਰਿਸਟ ਹੋਏ; ਡੂਬਤਾ ਇਵ ਜਗੁ ॥੧॥
Through them even pure hearts in the world become polluted; thus the world is drowning. ॥1॥
In the world, the Lord's Name is the most sublime.
ਅਖੀ ਤ ਮੀਟਹਿ. ਨਾਕ ਪਕੜਹਿ; ਠਗਣ ਕਉ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
They close their eyes and hold their noses only to deceive the world. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਆਂਟ ਸੇਤੀ ਨਾਕੁ ਪਕੜਹਿ; ਸੂਝਤੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਲੋਅ ॥
They hold their nose with thumb and two fingers, and claim to see the three worlds,
663: ਮਗਰ ਪਾਛੈ. ਕਛੁ, ਨ ਸੂਝੈ; ਏਹੁ ਪਦਮੁ ਅਲੋਅ ॥੨॥
yet cannot see what lies behind their own back; what a wondrous lotus posture! ॥2॥
ਖਤ੍ਰੀਆ ਤ ਧਰਮੁ ਛੋਡਿਆ; ਮਲੇਛ ਭਾਖਿਆ ਗਹੀ ॥
The Kshatriyas have abandoned their duty, and taken up the language of those they call foreigners.
ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਇਕ ਵਰਨ ਹੋਈ; ਧਰਮ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਰਹੀ ॥੩॥
The whole world has become of one caste; the order of dharma is gone. ॥3॥
ਅਸਟ ਸਾਜ ਸਾਜਿ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਸੋਧਹਿ; ਕਰਹਿ ਬੇਦ ਅਭਿਆਸੁ ॥
They compose grammars and study the Puranas, and recite the Vedas,
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ; ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੬॥੮॥
but without the Lord's Name there is no liberation, says servant Nanak. ॥4॥1॥6॥8॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਗਗਨ ਮੈ ਥਾਲੁ. ਰਵਿ ਚੰਦੁ ਦੀਪਕ ਬਨੇ; ਤਾਰਿਕਾ ਮੰਡਲ ਜਨਕ ਮੋਤੀ ॥
The whole sky is the tray, the sun and moon are the lamps, and the stars are the pearls.
ਧੂਪੁ ਮਲਆਨਲੋ. ਪਵਣੁ ਚਵਰੋ ਕਰੇ; ਸਗਲ ਬਨਰਾਇ ਫੂਲੰਤ ਜੋਤੀ ॥੧॥
The breeze from the sandalwood hills is the incense, the wind waves the fan, and all the vegetation offers flowers to You, O Light. ॥1॥
ਕੈਸੀ ਆਰਤੀ ਹੋਇ; ਭਵ ਖੰਡਨਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਰਤੀ ॥
What a beautiful aarti this is, O Destroyer of birth and death!
The unstruck current of life is the drum sounding for Your aarti. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਸਹਸ ਤਵ ਨੈਨ. ਨਨ ਨੈਨ ਹੈ ਤੋਹਿ ਕਉ; ਸਹਸ ਮੂਰਤਿ. ਨਨਾ ਏਕ ਤੋਹੀ ॥
You have thousands of eyes, yet You have no eye; thousands of forms, yet not one form.
ਸਹਸ ਪਦ ਬਿਮਲ. ਨਨ ਏਕ ਪਦ; ਗੰਧ ਬਿਨੁ. ਸਹਸ ਤਵ ਗੰਧ; ਇਵ ਚਲਤ ਮੋਹੀ ॥੨॥
You have thousands of pure feet, yet not one foot; thousands of noses, yet no nose. Such wonders of Yours amaze me. ॥2॥
ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ; ਜੋਤਿ ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
The Light within all is His Light alone.
ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਚਾਨਣਿ; ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
By His radiance all are illumined;
but this Light is revealed through the Guru's teaching.
ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਸੁ ਆਰਤੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
Whatever pleases Him is the true aarti. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ. ਲੋਭਿਤ ਮਨੋ; ਅਨਦਿਨੋ ਮੋਹਿ ਆਹੀ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
My mind longs for the nectar of the Lord's lotus feet; night and day I thirst for it.
ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਲੁ ਦੇਹਿ. ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਰਿੰਗ ਕਉ; ਹੋਇ ਜਾ ਤੇ. ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੭॥੯॥
Give the water of Your grace to Nanak, the rainbird, so that he may dwell in Your Name. ॥4॥1॥7॥9॥
Dhanasri · Chaupade · Guru Amar Das · Ghar 2
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ; ਨ ਨਿਖੁਟੈ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
This treasure of the Name is inexhaustible; it never runs out and is never lost.
The Perfect True Guru has shown it to me.
ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ; ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
I am ever a sacrifice to my True Guru;
ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ; ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੧॥
by the Guru's grace I enshrine the Lord in my mind. ॥1॥
ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
They alone are wealthy who attune themselves to the Lord's Name,
ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ. ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ. ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
in whom the Perfect Guru has revealed the Lord's wealth; by the Lord's grace it comes to dwell in the mind. ॥ Rahao
Cutting away faults, the Guru enshrines the Lord's praises in the heart,
and through the Perfect Guru the mind rests in natural poise.
The Perfect Guru's true Bani of the Lord's praise
brings waves of joy within the mind, and it merges in poise. ॥2॥
the Guru ends duality and enshrines the Lord in the mind.
The Name is priceless; it cannot be bought,
but by the Guru's grace it comes to dwell in the mind. ॥3॥
ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਸੈ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥
The one God dwells in all,
yet through the Guru's teaching He is revealed in the heart.
Whoever, in poise, has come to know God and recognised Him within,
664: Nanak: obtains the Name, and the mind is content. ॥4॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਅਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
The Lord's Name is a pure and utterly boundless wealth;
through the Guru's Word its storehouses are filled.
ਨਾਮ ਧਨ ਬਿਨੁ; ਹੋਰ ਸਭ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
Know that all wealth other than the Name is poison;
it breeds pride, and one burns in attachment to Maya. ॥1॥
Whoever, through the Guru, tastes the Lord's essence
ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
is ever in bliss, day and night; but it is obtained only by perfect destiny. ॥ Rahao
The Shabad is a lamp that lights the three worlds;
Through the pure Name one washes away the filth of ego;
through true devotion there is lasting peace. ॥2॥
ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ; ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਲੋਗੁ ॥
Whoever has tasted the Lord's essence becomes the Lord's servant;
ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਖੁ; ਨਾਹੀ ਕਦੇ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
such a one is ever in joy, and never grieves.
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ; ਹਰਿ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
they chant the Lord's Name and find peace from the Lord. ॥3॥
Without the True Guru, all the world cries out and dies spiritually;
night and day people burn, and find no peace.
When one meets the True Guru, the Guru quenches all thirst;
Nanak: through the Name one finds peace and joy. ॥4॥2॥
Keep the Name within you, the wealth that stays with you forever,
the Name of the One who cherishes all beings and creatures.
The treasure of liberation is obtained by those
ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
who are dyed in the Lord's Name, lovingly attuned. ॥1॥
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Through service to the Guru one obtains the wealth of the Lord's Name;
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
whoever meditates on the Lord's Name is illumined within. ॥ Rahao
ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਗੂੜਾ; ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਹੋਇ ॥
This deep colour of the Husband Lord's love comes to the soul-bride
who makes peace her adornment; she ever keeps God enshrined within.
ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ. ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
In ego, no one finds God;
strayed from the Source of life, one wastes this human birth. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰ ਤੇ; ਸਾਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Through the Bani received from the Guru come peace, poise and joy;
the service the Guru teaches is true, and through it one merges in the Name.
Whoever is joined to the Shabad ever meditates on the Beloved,
and merging in the True Name receives honour. ॥3॥
The Creator Himself is present in every age;
when He casts His glance of grace, union takes place.
Through the Guru's Bani such a one enshrines the Lord in the mind.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ; ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੪॥੩॥
Nanak: those whom God Himself unites stay dyed in the True One. ॥4॥3॥
Caught in attachment to Maya, the world is filthy, and grows ever filthier;
lured by duality, it comes and goes.
Through love of duality all people are ruined;
ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ; ਅਪੁਨੀ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥੧॥
the self-willed take blows and lose their honour. ॥1॥
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ; ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Through service to the Guru one becomes pure;
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ; ਪਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the Name dwells within, and one receives the highest honour. ॥ Rahao
The Guru-oriented are saved in the Lord's sanctuary;
dyed in the Lord's Name, they keep devotion firmly within.
The one who worships the Lord receives honour;
those dyed in the True One remain absorbed in joy and poise. ॥2॥
ਸਾਚੇ ਕਾ ਗਾਹਕੁ; ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
Know that rare is the one who seeks the True One;
such a one, through the Guru's Word, comes to examine their own self.
Their capital is true, and their trade is true;
ਸੋ ਧੰਨੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ; ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੩॥
blessed is the one who loves the Name. ॥3॥
ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਾਚੈ; ਇਕਿ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
The True God has joined some to His True Name;
to them He has the Guru's sublime Bani and Shabad recited.
665: This is the unchanging way of the True God:
Nanak, He adorns lives by joining them to His Name. ॥4॥4॥
ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹਿ; ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
I am a sacrifice to those who serve the Lord.
ਤਿਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਾਚੁ; ਸਚਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
The True One dwells in their hearts, and the True Name is on their lips.
Cherish the Truest of the true, and pain departs;
through the True Word, the Name comes to dwell in the mind. ॥1॥
Listen to the Guru's Bani; it washes away the filth,
ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and with natural ease enshrines the Lord's Name in the mind. ॥1॥ Rahao
It ends falsehood and deceit, and quenches the fire of desire;
there is peace within, and one finds joy in poise.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੈ; ਤਾ ਆਪੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
When one walks in the Guru's will, self-conceit departs,
ਸਾਚੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਏ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥
and singing the Lord's praises one finds the true abode. ॥2॥
ਨ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੂਝੈ; ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
One who neither understands the Shabad nor knows the Bani,
blind and self-willed, passes life in pain.
When such a one meets the True Guru, peace is found,
and the Guru stills the ego within. ॥3॥
ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ; ਦਾਤਾ ਇਕੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
To whom else can we plead? He alone is the Giver.
When He shows grace, union comes through the Shabad.
Meeting the Beloved Guru, I would sing the True One's praises;
Nanak: chanting the True One, I would become pleasing to the True One. ॥4॥5॥
When the mind dies to vice, its restless craving dies too.
ਬਿਨੁ ਮਨ ਮੂਏ; ਕੈਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
Unless the mind dies to vice, how can one find the Lord?
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਰੈ; ਦਾਰੂ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Rare is the one who knows the medicine by which this mind dies to vice;
ਮਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ; ਬੂਝੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
that one understands that the mind dies through the Shabad. ॥1॥
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੇ; ਹਰਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
The one whom the Lord forgives and honours,
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ; ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
in that one's mind the Name comes to dwell, by the Guru's grace. ॥ Rahao
When, through the Guru, one does the work worth doing,
ਤਾ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
The mind is drunk with ego, like a maddened elephant;
the Guru alone, with the goad of the Shabad, can bring the dead mind back to life. ॥2॥
The mind is hard to tame; rare is the one who tames it.
When one ends its incurable disease, it becomes pure.
The Guru-oriented one makes this mind beautiful,
and casts out ego and vice from within. ॥3॥
Those whom He has kept joined to Himself from the start
are never separated; they remain merged in the Shabad.
God Himself knows His own hidden power;
Nanak: the Guru-oriented one comes to know the Name. ॥4॥6॥
The foolish and ignorant hoard perishable wealth;
the self-willed, blinded by Maya, go astray.
ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੈ ਧਨਿ; ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
The wealth of Maya brings only pain;
ਨਾ ਸਾਥਿ ਜਾਇ; ਨ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
it does not go with anyone, nor does it bring contentment. ॥1॥
True wealth is obtained through the Guru's teaching;
ਕਾਚਾ ਧਨੁ. ਫੁਨਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
perishable wealth comes and goes. ॥ Rahao
The self-willed fools go astray and all die spiritually;
ਭਵਜਲਿ ਡੂਬੇ; ਨ ਉਰਵਾਰਿ. ਨ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
they drown in the terrifying world-ocean, belonging neither to this shore nor the other.
Those who meet the True Guru by perfect destiny
are dyed in the True Name, detached day and night. ॥2॥
ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Through all four ages the true Bani of praise gives the water of life;
by perfect destiny one merges in the Lord's Name through it.
Siddhas and seekers throughout the world long for it,
but it is obtained only by perfect destiny. ॥3॥
ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਚਾ; ਸਾਚਾ ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
To the rare one who knows the sublime Lord, everything appears as the True One;
such a one sees the True One dwelling everywhere.
The True One Himself implants His True Name in the heart.
666: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ; ਆਪੇ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਏ ॥੪॥੭॥
Nanak: He Himself watches over all, and Himself joins them to the Truth. ॥4॥7॥
ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ; ਕਹੀ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
The worth and power of the Name cannot be told.
ਸੇ ਜਨ ਧੰਨੁ; ਜਿਨ ਇਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Blessed are those who are lovingly attuned to the one Name.
The one who takes the Guru's unerring teaching dwells on the True One's virtues;
but God gives this understanding only to those He forgives. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
The Lord's Name has wondrous power; God Himself makes one hear it.
ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਵਿਚਿ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In this age of strife, only the Guru-oriented obtain it. ॥1॥ Rahao
Look within the mind: we are utter fools,
for we do all our deeds in ego.
This ego goes only by the Guru's grace,
and the Guru unites only those whom God Himself forgives. ॥2॥
The wealth of Maya breeds great pride;
drowned in ego, one receives no honour before the Lord.
Giving up self-conceit, one is ever at peace.
Through the Guru's teaching I praise that True One. ॥3॥
ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ; ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
there is no other like Him.
Only the one whom He joins to the Truth is attached to it.
Nanak: through the Name there is lasting peace, here and hereafter. ॥4॥8॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਹਮ ਭੀਖਕ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਤੇਰੇ; ਤੂ ਨਿਜ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
We are beggars at Your door; You are the independent Giver to all.
ਹੋਹੁ ਦੈਆਲ. ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨ ਕੰਉ; ਸਦਾ ਰਹਉ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
Be merciful and give Your Name to this beggar, that I may ever stay dyed in Your love. ॥1॥
ਹੰਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ; ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ॥
I am a sacrifice to Your True Name.
ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਏਕੋ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You alone are the Cause of causes, the Creator of all; there is no other. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਬਹੁਤੇ ਫੇਰ ਪਏ ਕਿਰਪਨ ਕਉ; ਅਬ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
This wretched one has gone through many rounds of birth; now show a little grace.
ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ; ਐਸੀ ਬਖਸ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
Be merciful and grant such a blessing, that You give me Your vision. ॥2॥
ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਭਰਮ ਪਟ ਖੂਲੑੇ; ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Says Nanak: the one whose veils of doubt are opened by the Guru's grace comes to know the Lord;
ਸਾਚੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਹੈ ਭੀਤਰਿ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੩॥੧॥੯॥
true love wells up within, and the mind is won over by the True Guru. ॥3॥1॥9॥
Dhanasri · Chaupade · Guru Ram Das · Ghar 1
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ; ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਪ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
O Lord, You remove all the sins of the saints and devotees who serve You.
ਹਮ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਰਖੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ. ਤੁਮ ਜੁ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੧॥
Show grace to us too, O Master, and keep us in the company You love. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ. ਨ ਸਕਉ; ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
I cannot describe Your virtues, O Lord of the world.
ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਥਰ ਨੀਰਿ ਡੁਬਤ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਖਣ ਹਮ ਤਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
We sinners are sinking like stones in water; show grace, and carry us stones across. ॥ Rahao
ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਲਾਗੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਮੋਰਚਾ; ਲਗਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
The rust and poison of sin, clinging through many births, is cleansed in the company of the holy,
ਜਿਉ ਕੰਚਨੁ. ਬੈਸੰਤਰਿ ਤਾਇਓ; ਮਲੁ ਕਾਟੀ ਕਟਿਤ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
just as gold heated in the fire has its dross cut away. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੁ. ਜਪਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ. ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
So day and night I chant the Lord's Name, and chanting it I keep the Lord in my heart.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ. ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਜਗਿ ਪੂਰਾ; ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ. ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
The Lord's Name is the unfailing medicine in the world; chanting it, ego is killed. ॥3॥
667: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ; ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਪਾਰੀ ॥
O Lord, unreachable, unfathomable, beyond all beyond, all-pervading and infinite,
ਜਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
show grace to Your servants, O Life of the world; Nanak prays: save the honour of Your servants. ॥4॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ. ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ; ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੀ ॥
The Lord's saints who chanted the Lord's Name are rid of all pain, doubt and fear.
ਅਪਨੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਈ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
He Himself has them perform His service, and the Guru's teaching awakens within them. ॥1॥
The one dyed in the Lord's Name is detached from Maya.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣੀ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Hearing the Lord's praises, the mind is pleased, and through the Guru's teaching it is attuned to the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਤੁਮੑ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਮ ਸਾਂਗੀ ॥
O Lord Master, You Yourself are the caste of the saints; You are the Master, and we follow in Your footsteps.
ਜੈਸੀ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਹਮ ਤੈਸੇ ਬੁਲਗ ਬੁਲਾਗੀ ॥੨॥
As is the understanding You give us, O Lord Master, so do we speak. ॥2॥
ਕਿਆ ਹਮ ਕਿਰਮ. ਨਾਨੑ ਨਿਕ ਕੀਰੇ; ਤੁਮੑ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਡਾਗੀ ॥
What are we? Tiny worms and little insects; You are the great, exalted Being.
ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹਿ, ਨ ਸਕਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਹਮ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਹ ਅਭਾਗੀ ॥੩॥
We cannot describe Your state and extent, O God; how can we unfortunate ones meet You by our own effort? ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਹੁ; ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
O Lord God, Master, show grace, that we may be attached to Your service.
ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਕਥਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
Nanak: make us the slaves of Your slaves, O God, that we may keep speaking Your praises. ॥4॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੰਤੁ. ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖਾ; ਜੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
The True Guru, the great Being, is the Lord's saint, who utters the Bani of the Lord's praise.
ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ; ਹਮ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
Whoever recites or hears it is freed from sin; I am ever a sacrifice to that Guru. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ. ਸੁਨਹੁ ਜਸੁ ਕਾਨੀ ॥
O saints of the Lord, listen attentively to His praises.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਹੁ. ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਪਲ; ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Hear the Lord's praises even for an instant, a moment, and all sins and faults are washed away. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਐਸਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਸਾਧੁ ਜਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ; ਤੇ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਡਾਨੀ ॥
Those who have found such a holy saint, the Guru, have become great and exalted.
ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਮੰਗਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਲੋਚ ਲੁਚਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
O God, Master, I beg for the dust of their feet; I long for it. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਫਲਿਓ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਜਿਨ ਜਪਿਓ ਸੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੀ ॥
O Lord God, Master, You are a tree bearing every fruit; those who chanted Your Name are satisfied.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ; ਸਭ ਲਾਥੀ ਭੂਖ ਭੁਖਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
Drinking the Lord's amrit they are fulfilled, and all their hunger departs. ॥3॥
ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਵਡੇ ਭਾਗ ਵਡ ਊਚੇ; ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਜਪਾਨੀ ॥
Those with great and lofty destiny chant the Lord's Name.
ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੩॥
O Lord God, Master, unite me with their company; servant Nanak, make me the slave of their slaves. ॥4॥3॥
ਹਮ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਅੰਧ. ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਰਾਤੇ; ਕਿਉ ਚਾਲਹ. ਗੁਰ ਚਾਲੀ ॥
We are utterly blind, engrossed in the poison of worldly things; how can we walk the Guru's way?
ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਹਮ ਲਾਵੈ ਆਪਨ ਪਾਲੀ ॥੧॥
May the True Guru, Giver of peace, show mercy and attach us to his hem. ॥1॥
O Gursikh friends, walk the Guru's way.
ਜੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੈ. ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨਹੁ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Whatever the Guru says, accept it as good; the Lord's praise is wondrous. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ. ਸੁਣਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ; ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਬੇਗਿ ਬੇਗਾਲੀ ॥
Listen, O saints of the Lord, O brothers: take refuge in the Guru quickly.
ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ. ਖਰਚੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਧਹੁ; ਮਤ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਆਜੁ ਕਿ ਕਾਲੑੀ ॥੨॥
Serving the True Guru, pack the provisions of the Lord's Name; do not think, today or tomorrow. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ. ਜਪਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਣਾ; ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤੁ ਚਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੀ ॥
O saints of the Lord, chant the Lord's Name; the Lord's saint walks in the Lord's will.
ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ. ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਏ; ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕੇਲ ਕੇਲਾਲੀ ॥੩॥
Those who chanted the Lord's Name became one with the Lord; the playful Lord met them. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੁ ਜਪਿ. ਲੋਚ ਲੋੁਚਾਨੀ; ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਬਨਵਾਲੀ ॥
I long to chant the Lord's Name; show grace, O Lord of the world.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ. ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ; ਹਮ. ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਪਗ ਰਾਲੀ ॥੪॥੪॥
Servant Nanak: unite me with the company of the holy, O Lord, and make me the dust of the holy ones' feet. ॥4॥4॥
668: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਭਏ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਹਮ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਬਿਲਲ ਬਿਲਲਾਤੀ ॥
O Lord, Master, I am a rainbird crying out; may Your Name become the raindrop for me.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੀ; ਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਮਖਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
O Lord God, show Your grace, and place it in my mouth even for an instant. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ. ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ; ਇਕ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
Without the Lord I cannot live even for a moment.
ਜਿਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਮਲੈ. ਅਮਲੀ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈ ਹੈ; ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ. ਹਮ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
As an addict without his drug is in torment, so without the Lord I am in anguish. ॥ Rahao
ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਵਰ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਾਹ; ਹਮ. ਲਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ, ਅੰਤੁ ਮਾਤੀ ॥
You, O Lord, are an ocean of virtue, unfathomably deep; we cannot find even a trace of Your limit.
ਤੂ ਪਰੈ ਪਰੈ. ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਮਿਤਿ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਆਪਨ ਗਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
You are beyond the beyond, infinite, O Master; You alone know Your state and extent. ॥2॥

ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
O Master, Giver to all beings, show grace and save me. ॥2॥
ਤੇਰਾ ਵਰਨੁ. ਨ ਜਾਪੈ, ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ; ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ. ਕਉਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Your colour cannot be seen, nor Your form; who can reckon Your power?
ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ. ਰਵਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਠਾਈ; ਅਗਮ ਰੂਪ ਗਿਰਧਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
O unreachable Lord, Upholder of the earth, You pervade water, land and sky, everywhere. ॥3॥
ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੀ; ਤੂ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
All Your servants sing Your praises; You are the imperishable, all-pervading Lord.
ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
Keep me as it pleases You, O Master; servant Nanak has come to Your door, to Your sanctuary. ॥4॥1॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ. ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਤਜੇ ਹੈ ਮੀਨਾ; ਜਿਨਿ ਜਲ ਸਿਉ ਹੇਤੁ ਬਢਾਇਓ ॥
The fish gives up its life without water, because it has deepened its love for water.
ਕਮਲ ਹੇਤਿ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਹੈ ਭਵਰਾ; ਉਨਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਨਿਕਸਿ. ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
For love of the lotus the bumblebee perishes, for it could not find the way out. ॥1॥
ਅਬ ਮਨ; ਏਕਸ ਸਿਉ ਮੋਹੁ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
O mind, the one who now loves the One Lord
ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ. ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੰਗੇ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਚੀਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
does not die or come and go, but abides ever with Him, recognising Him through the True Guru's Shabad. ॥1॥ Rahao
